doEcho = function(type, dam, eff, target, src, x, y)
		if type == DamageType.LIGHT then
			target:setEffect(target.EFF_ECHOED_LIGHT, eff.echo_dur, {power = dam * eff.slow_per, max = eff.slow_max})
		elseif type == DamageType.DARKNESS then --you can never be too sure
			local echo
			if eff.dark_echoes then for _, e in ipairs(eff.dark_echoes) do
				if e.duration > 0 and e.x == x and e.y == y then
					echo = e
				end
			end end
			if not echo then
				game.level.map:addEffect(src, 
					x, y, 4,
					DamageType.DARKNESS, dam * eff.dam_factor,
					0,
					5, nil,
					{type="shadow_zone"},
					nil, src:spellFriendlyFire()
				)
				--it's hacky yeah, but map:addEffect should really return the instance
				echo = game.level.map.effects[#game.level.map.effects]
				eff.dark_echoes = eff.dark_echoes or {}
				table.insert(eff.dark_echoes, echo)
			else
				if echo.duration < eff.echo_dur and echo.duration > 0 then
					old_dur = echo.duration
					old_dam = old_dur * echo.dam
					local new_dam = dam * eff.dam_factor * eff.echo_dur + old_dam
					echo.duration = eff.echo_dur
					echo.dam = new_dam / eff.echo_dur
				else
					
				end
			end
		end
	end,

DamageType={LIGHT=1,DARKNESS=2}
local def={
	doEcho = function(type, dam, eff, target, src, x, y)
		if type == DamageType.LIGHT then
			target:setEffect(target.EFF_ECHOED_LIGHT, eff.echo_dur, {power = dam * eff.slow_per, max = eff.slow_max})
		elseif type == DamageType.DARKNESS then --you can never be too sure
			local echo
			if eff.dark_echoes then for _, e in ipairs(eff.dark_echoes) do
				if e.duration > 0 and e.x == x and e.y == y then
					echo = e
				end
			end end
			if not echo then
				game.level.map:addEffect(src, 
					x, y, 4,
					DamageType.DARKNESS, dam * eff.dam_factor,
					0,
					5, nil,
					{type="shadow_zone"},
					nil, src:spellFriendlyFire()
				)
				--it's hacky yeah, but map:addEffect should really return the instance
				echo = game.level.map.effects[#game.level.map.effects]
				eff.dark_echoes = eff.dark_echoes or {}
				table.insert(eff.dark_echoes, echo)
			else
				if echo.duration < eff.echo_dur and echo.duration > 0 then
					old_dur = echo.duration
					old_dam = old_dur * echo.dam
					local new_dam = dam * eff.dam_factor * eff.echo_dur + old_dam
					echo.duration = eff.echo_dur
					echo.dam = new_dam / eff.echo_dur
				else
					
				end
			end
		end
	end,
}
local src={spellFriendlyFire=function()return false end}
local map={effects={},addEffect=function(self,source,x,y,dur,dt,dam)self.effects[#self.effects+1]={x=x,y=y,duration=dur,dam=dam}end}
game={level={map=map}}
local target={EFF_ECHOED_LIGHT=1,setEffect=function(self,id,dur,p)self.effect={dur=dur,p=p}end}
local eff={echo_dur=3,dam_factor=.1,slow_per=.001,slow_max=.3}
def.doEcho(DamageType.LIGHT,800,eff,target,src,0,0)
assert(target.effect.p.power==.8 and target.effect.p.max==.3 and target.effect.dur==3)
def.doEcho(DamageType.DARKNESS,100,eff,target,src,0,0)
local e=map.effects[1];assert(e.duration==4 and e.dam==10)
for _,remaining in ipairs({4,3})do e.duration=remaining;def.doEcho(DamageType.DARKNESS,100,eff,target,src,0,0);assert(e.duration==remaining and e.dam==10)end
e.duration=2;def.doEcho(DamageType.DARKNESS,100,eff,target,src,0,0);assert(e.duration==3 and math.abs(e.dam-50/3)<1e-9)
local before=e.dam;def.doEcho(DamageType.LIGHT,100,eff,target,src,0,0);assert(e.duration==3 and e.dam==before)
e.duration=0;def.doEcho(DamageType.DARKNESS,100,eff,target,src,0,0);assert(#map.effects==2 and map.effects[2].duration==4)
